sourceReview.method: Verified resident frame_batch4 and frame header-only zeroing (avoiding 2.51 MB / 626 KB unused streaming weight-slot zeroing per submission), exact i16 roundtrip validation in output_valid and valid_plane_dot (replacing 5.57 million scalar truncf calls per projection), branchless activation bitplane extraction, fused padding/reconstruction validation, row-major outer loop in batch_four reconstruction (reducing strided 23.67 MB tensor.data reads by 4x while preserving exact per-128 FMA/nonfused order), and bounded multi-projection admission (1..=2 resident projections within the 64 MiB arena, 1..=4 streaming projections, beginning with blk.0.ffn_up.weight).
sourceReview.scope: Host-side bitplane/dot reconstruction optimization in HmxQ2Executor and bounded multi-projection resident HMX placement in prism-hexagon-model-probe and bonsai-tools model_device supervisor within the 64 MiB native arena and 24,000-operation session cap.

diagnosticEvaluationMilliseconds.power: Outer workload clock and all build/control steps observed AC power connected (Online) and 100% battery charge throughout the 132.245-second run (within the 540-second predeclared allowance). All four arm endpoints in both device controls observed AC connected, battery saver off, and 100% charge. Equal endpoints cannot prove uninterrupted stability.
diagnosticEvaluationMilliseconds.interpretation: Single-projection resident batch-four native evaluation reached 432.66 ms on token 2 (+17.22 ms vs 415.44 ms CPU arm) with 32.53-34.22 ms nativeSubmitAndWaitMilliseconds. Two-projection resident batch-four placement (blk.0.ffn_up.weight + blk.0.ffn_gate.weight, 50,135,040 resident weight bytes in 54,890,496 mapped bytes) achieved exact bitwise parity across all three tokens in 60 queue writes (240 logical operations), but doubled nativeSubmitAndWaitMilliseconds to 64.66-66.22 ms (~32.5 ms per projection) and increased native evaluation to 514.98-553.37 ms vs 411.89-579.56 ms on 4-worker NEON CPU. Each offloaded 17,408x2,560 projection still incurs 10 sequential batch-four FastRPC/MCDM queue submissions (~32.5 ms device round-trip) plus ~30-35 ms host-side 8-plane dot reconstruction, whereas 4-worker NEON CPU completes a single projection in ~2-3 ms.

defaultBlockers: The published CPU Prism runtime and server have no NPU serving integration. Changing the descriptive admission lock alone cannot enable offload.
The experimental session is terminal, at most 120 seconds, 64 MiB mapped shared buffer (at most 2 resident 25.07 MB FFN projections), and 24,000 logical operation attempts.

No matched end-to-end latency, energy or capacity benefit has been established. Adding a second resident HMX projection increases nativeSubmitAndWaitMilliseconds from ~33 ms to ~65 ms per token and total native evaluation to 514.98-553.37 ms.
Broader arithmetic/history, native ownership/lifecycle, persistent recovery, packaging/isolation and release acceptance remain incomplete.
nextConcreteImplementation: Reduce per-projection FastRPC/MCDM queue round-trips beyond four K=128 operations per packet (or evaluate full-projection/multi-tile DSP-side accumulation and parallel host plane reconstruction) so per-projection HMX latency drops below the ~2-3 ms 4-worker NEON CPU projection baseline before expanding resident arena capacity or attempting performance qualification.
